scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:web
scripts.dev:rust: cargo-watch --watch core/src --watch wasm/src -s 'wasm-pack build wasm --target bundler --dev'
scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace && cargo test
scripts.test:logic: npm run build:wasm && npm run test --workspace logic
scripts.test:web: npm run build:wasm && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test:tooling && npm run build && npm run test:rust && npm run test --workspace logic && npm run test --workspace web && npm run test:e2e --workspace web
